service.description: The equipment of the user's maintenance scope (a resource read: MAINTENANCE_VIEW, _ASSIGNED_VIEW or _RESOURCE_VIEW; PERMISSION_DENIED without), scoped in the query before paging: assets that are not stock, owned by one of the user's organizations or held at one of their facilities for an owner that is no internal organization. Found by id, name, serial, soft identifier or registration number, product, class, type, status, parent, facility (with those inside it), custodian and supplier warranty (expiring within thirty days, or expired); equipment that has left only with includeLeft. Each row carries its names, custodian and warranty state; no cost or book value. A holder of MAINTENANCE_ALL_ORGANIZATIONS with an active organization lists its equipment alone (F83), but a facility's equipment is read in the record check's scope.

The facilities of the user's maintenance scope (a resource read), each in an organization's scope by its owner or its nearest owning ancestor, found in the query before paging by name or id, type, organization, parent, bookable, minimum capacity and a current room feature; closed ones only with includeClosed. With roots, the top of the tree: the facilities whose parent is none or outside the scope, each such parent given once as an unnamed node (hiddenAncestor, key hidden-n) with the facilities under it, never its name or id; with parentFacilityId, one level (hidden-n names an unnamed node's); with facilityId, that facility alone. Rows carry the type, the organization, the time zone (own or inherited), the state, the children and equipment counts and the current room features. A holder of MAINTENANCE_ALL_ORGANIZATIONS with an active organization lists its facilities alone (F83), but a facility, or a level under a facility, is read in the record check's scope.

Register equipment (no assetId) or change one piece of the user's (MAINTENANCE_RESOURCE_EDIT). New equipment names an internal organization of the scope as owner (OWNER_UNAVAILABLE; the active one when not given), a facility of the scope and a type that is not stock (TYPE_INVALID), and is registered through EquipmentServices.create#Equipment (status in use, no quantity). A change goes through AssetServices.update#Asset with only the identity, name, comments, parent, class and supplier warranty given: never quantity, owner, location, cost or book fields (not AssetRecordServices.update#AssetMetadata, which is Warehouse's, impl-maintenance F17). A parent is equipment of the scope and never the equipment or one under it (PARENT_CYCLE); expectedRevision refuses a change since it was read (RECORD_CHANGED).

A meter reading of one piece of the user's equipment, the one meter writer (design §5.1, impl-maintenance F19, F70): MAINTENANCE_RESOURCE_EDIT, or MAINTENANCE_EXECUTE with the work (workEffortId, the step it was taken in) assigned to the user. The meter is one of the equipment model's (productMeterId, or productMeterTypeId) or a meter type for equipment whose model has none (METER_UNAVAILABLE), in its unit (UNIT_MISMATCH). The reading time is now or earlier (DATE_FUTURE) and no other reading of the equipment has it (READING_EXISTS: a reading is never overwritten). On a cumulative meter a reading below the one before or above the one after is READING_DECREASING unless the reason is a reset; a correction changes a reading taken (correctReadingDate). A reset and a correction need changeReason (REASON_REQUIRED), kept by the audit log with the value.

parameter.name: readingReasonEnumId
parameter.description: AmrReading (default), AmrWork (the default in work), AmrReset or AmrCorrection.

service.description: A registration of one piece of the user's equipment (MAINTENANCE_RESOURCE_EDIT), over AssetRegistration: a new one, or a change to one (assetRegSeqId). Needs a registration or license number (NUMBER_REQUIRED); through is not before from (DATES_INVALID).

The guarded custody change (design §6; impl-maintenance F18, F61): a new holder of a role (Custodian by default) of one piece of the user's equipment (MAINTENANCE_RESOURCE_EDIT), from an effective date now or earlier (DATE_FUTURE) and not before a current holder's start or inside another holder's ended holding (DATE_BEFORE_HOLDING). The role's current holders end and the new one starts at that date, through AssetServices.replace#AssetPartyAssignment; People's rule on the end of a holding then completes a separation's return task, as for People's and Warehouse's changes. The new holder is a person or an organization (PARTY_UNAVAILABLE).

One piece of the user's equipment to another facility (and an open location there) of the scope: MAINTENANCE_RESOURCE_EDIT, and to write Warehouse's STOCK_MOVE with both facilities in the user's facility scope (FacilityScope.js; RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). With preview nothing is written and the answer is the effect: facilities, organizations and time zones before and after, the child equipment that stays where it is and the bookings to come (counted). A move that would pass the equipment to another organization (a customer's equipment held at another organization's site) is ORGANIZATION_CHANGE; to where it is, SAME_LOCATION. AssetServices.move#Asset makes a new asset for a move to another facility (stock), so the asset's facility and location, both audit-logged, are written directly after the checks, and the asset leaves any container. Equipment only: stock and an asset with no type are refused (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), and no ledger posting follows (a fixed asset's book is by organization, which a move never changes).

What a move of one of the user's facilities under another parent, or its close, changes, before FacilityServices.store#Facility makes it (a resource read; nothing written): its organization and time zone before and after (each inherited from the nearest ancestor that has one), the facilities inside it that go with it, the equipment there and in them, and the bookings of it and its rooms from now on (counted, never named). Refuses a parent inside it (PARENT_CYCLE) and a facility or parent outside the scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).
